obligations.expected_behavior: An external process execution is subject to a finite time bound.
forbidden_result: An external process runs without a time bound.
obligations.observable_result: The external process terminates or is stopped within its configured finite time limit.
obligations.state_after: The external process has remained within the finite time bound.
obligations.subject: External process

obligations.expected_behavior: An external process execution is subject to a finite output bound.
forbidden_result: An external process produces output without a bound.
obligations.observable_result: The external process output remains within its configured finite limit.
obligations.state_after: The external process has remained within the finite output bound.
obligations.state_before: An external process is executing and producing output.
obligations.subject: External process

obligations.expected_behavior: An external process execution reaches a deterministic terminal state.
forbidden_result: The external process ends in an indeterminate or nondeterministic terminal state.
obligations.observable_result: The terminal state of the external process is deterministically identified.
obligations.state_after: The external process is in a deterministic terminal state.
obligations.subject: External process
obligations.trigger: When each external process execution terminates

obligations.expected_behavior: Budget exhaustion results in an unsuccessful outcome.
forbidden_result: A budget-exhausted execution is reported as successful.
A budget-exhausted execution lacks an unsuccessful terminal outcome.
obligations.observable_result: When the applicable time or output budget is exhausted, the execution is marked unsuccessful.
obligations.state_after: The budget-exhausted execution has an unsuccessful terminal outcome.
obligations.state_before: An external process or aggregate is executing with an applicable budget that becomes exhausted.
obligations.subject: Budgeted external process or aggregate execution
obligations.trigger: When the execution budget is exhausted
